_: Single source for every published figure. Each number is transcribed from the RESULTS verdict named in its `source`, and both renderers (llmopt/lab/figures.py for paper SVG, llmopt/lab/figsvg.py for web) read THIS file — so a corrected number cannot survive in one renderer and not the other. Re-run scripts/gen_readme_figures.py and scripts/gen_figures_web.py after any amendment.

merge_space.title: Averaging independently born weights does not degrade a model — it ends it
merge_space.scope: All six independent-pair averages gated exactly zero, at every level. Merges inside a shared-init lineage land in the parent band.
merge_space.fence: VERDICT MERGE-SPACE-1/4 · RESULTS.md#L26770 · d64 · RTX 3080 · n=1 per cell

ssm_star.title: The house's first state-space model lost on both axes
ssm_star.scope: Paired arms: same device, same diet, same seed. The state-space arm also trained 22.6× slower. Booked as a loss, like every other result here.
ssm_star.fence: VERDICT SSM-STAR-1 · RESULTS.md#L27282 · d64 · RTX 3080 · n=1

effective_context.title: Width buys the ability to exploit long context, not local precision
effective_context.scope: Loss at deep positions when the model may see only the last k tokens. The widths are indistinguishable to k=16 and separate steadily after it.
effective_context.xlabel: context the model may see, k (tokens)
effective_context.fence: PRE-REG KEFF-PROBE-1 · 400 fixed rows · Mac CPU · no training required

loss_floor.title: The training floor walks down with width — and stops nowhere near the corpus limit
loss_floor.scope: Fresh births on one warm diet, fp32. Eight times the width buys roughly one token of effective context.

routing_crest.title: Which experts you keep is the difference between 0 and 82 of 120
routing_crest.scope: A resident 30B-class mixture-of-experts, masked to 58 of its 128 experts per layer. At that identical keep fraction, demand-ranked selection beats the full model while random and anti-demand selection score nothing at all. The effect is selection, not sparsity.
routing_crest.fence: VERDICT MOE-GT-1-R5/R6 · RESULTS.md#L18927 · +14.7 pooled over 6 paired seeds · Mac MLX · mathgen L1-3

honesty_ledger.title: A fifth of the published record argues against the lab
honesty_ledger.scope: Every claim in FINDINGS carries exactly one maturity tag. Nulls and retractions are published beside the wins, at the same prominence, because a ledger that only records successes cannot be checked.
honesty_ledger.fence: docs/FINDINGS.md · 187 curated claims · recounted from the source at build time

width_curve.title: Capability peaks at 45M parameters and falls away on both sides
width_curve.scope: One diet, one recipe, one gate. Past the peak, more parameters made the model worse — the corpus, not the capacity, is the binding constraint.
width_curve.fence: docs/FINDINGS.md micro-model program · Mac-lineage gates · 200M and 400M are 1-epoch points
